item.title: [Hike - Intermediate] 10Km Fast Pace - Heber Down - Whitby — Sun Sep 6, 8:45 AM
item.description:
GTA Hiking & Stuff Heber Down Conservation!
This is a **fast-paced** intermediate hike (**Going between 4.5-5km/hr**) with few stops. The beginning will be flat with the paved sections, and we will be going into the back trails. We will cover about 10km in 2 hours, **with minimal breaks**.
**Not a beginner hike!**
**THIS HIKE STARTS AT 8:50am**
Bring a water bottle and dress for the weather.
Be prepared.
We are going to meet at the Old Cullen Gardens parking lot. Intersection Cochrane & Taunton.
Go to the back of the parking lot near the new Pickleball courts. The path starts to the left of the picnic shelter.
**Hike leaves promptly at 8:50am**
